title: Daolytics
tagline: DAOlytics: Analytics platform for transparent DAO governance.
description: DAOlytics is an open-source analytics platform designed to demystify the complex world of on-chain DAO governance. We transform raw, fragmented, and often incomprehensible blockchain data into a clear, insightful, and interactive experience. Our key feature is that it allows anyone—from a seasoned delegate to a brand new token holder—to ask complex questions about governance proposals in plain English and get immediate, data-driven answers.
how_its_made:
DAOlytics is a full-stack decentralized application that combines a decentralized indexing layer with a modern web frontend. It is architected to support a powerful future AI intelligence layer.

Technologies Used
Frontend: Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Apollo Client, Ethers.js
Data & Indexing Layer (Backend): The Graph Protocol (Subgraphs)
Blockchain Indexed: Ethereum Mainnet (Uniswap DAO)
Deployment: The Graph Studio (Subgraph)
